verdict_a_acceptance.result: ACCEPTED from source; live release outcome remains unverified
evidence: scripts/_tool-db-row-validation.ts accepts required as a boolean or an array whose every member is a string; malformed mixed-type arrays and object-valued required are rejected.
scripts/dump-tools-from-db.ts labels a top-level input required only when required === true, so rect.required child names do not mark rect as required.
tests/unit/tool-db-row-validation.test.ts contains positive screenshot_region rect.required string-array and negative malformed-array cases.
tests/unit/private-catalog-commands.test.ts exercises doc output for nested required members and rejection of malformed nested-required arrays before docs writes.
verdict_a_acceptance.live_evidence: The defect record reports a live screenshot_region.parameters.rect.required array was the release failure trigger; this reviewer did not run the release or query live data.

findings: The validator intentionally permits unknown JSON Schema keywords but validates only each top-level parameter object. It does not recursively validate properties or array item schemas; malformed deeper required values could pass as a row. This is outside the demonstrated live shape but limits the broad claim that malformed schema rows refuse.
The new tests appear to target both regression directions, but their execution and the real release retest are root-owned and remain unverified here.

open_questions: Did the root-owned focused tests and strict release retest pass against the live catalog?
Does the DB contract permit arbitrary nested JSON Schema keywords, or should recursive validation be in scope?

coordinator_adjudication.finding: CONFIRMED limitation; not a blocker for this row-reader contract
coordinator_adjudication.reason: Both consumers read parameter type, enum and boolean required only (dump-tools-from-db.ts:39-45, check-tool-db-drift.ts:243-283). Nested properties/items remain unknown passthrough in DbToolRow and are neither interpreted nor claimed validated. A full JSON Schema validator is outside this correction; no claim of recursive schema certification is made.
coordinator_adjudication.cost_if_wrong: A malformed unused nested schema remains undetected by these release readers; runtime schema certification is not provided by this gate.
